text: {"lessons":["My account value rose over these periods, including several months when I made no trades; patience can be better than reacting to every price move.","Selling B, D, and A at gains does not prove I timed them well. With random prices, I should not treat recent gains as a signal about what comes next.","I should make each buy, sell, or hold decision using a consistent portfolio plan—not my purchase price, loss aversion, or reluctance to admit a mistake."]}
